system.name: DecDEC
system.one_liner: a CPU-augmented inference system for quantized LLMs that performs decoding with dynamic error compensation fetched from CPU memory

components.role: example linear layer (GEMV) in a transformer block that DecDEC augments

components.name: GPU Memory
components.role: holds the quantized base weights and the input activation vector

components.name: Q_b(W)
components.role: the base-quantized weight matrix W̃ used for the base GEMV

components.name: Base GEMV
components.role: computes the base output o_b = W x using the base-quantized weights

components.name: CPU Memory
components.role: holds the quantized weight residuals used for dynamic error compensation

components.name: Q_r(R)
components.role: the quantized weight residual R̃ stored in CPU memory

components.name: Dynamic Error Compensation
components.role: the four-step process that computes and adds an error-compensation term to the base GEMV output

components.name: Channel Selection
components.role: step 1: selects salient channel indices (sc_indices) from the input activation vector

components.name: Residual Fetch
components.role: step 2: fetches the quantized residuals for the selected channels from CPU memory over PCIe

components.name: Residual GEMV
components.role: step 3: computes the error compensation term o_dec from the fetched residuals and selected activations

components.name: Addition
components.role: step 4: adds o_dec to the base GEMV result o_b to produce the final output o

content.key_idea: DecDEC augments each linear layer's base GEMV with a lightweight four-step dynamic error compensation pipeline that selects salient input channels, fetches only their quantized weight residuals from CPU memory, and adds the correction to the base output.
content.reading_order: Left side shows which linear layer in a transformer block is augmented; right side reads left to right: GPU-resident base weights/input feed Base GEMV at top, while the numbered ①-④ Dynamic Error Compensation pipeline (Channel Selection, Residual Fetch from CPU Memory, Residual GEMV, Addition) runs in parallel below and merges into the final output on the right.

summary: This figure shows the overview of DecDEC, a CPU-augmented decoding system for low-bit quantized LLMs. A small left-hand panel indicates that DecDEC augments a linear (GEMV) layer inside a standard transformer block (e.g., Q/K/V, output, gate/up, or down projections). The main diagram shows GPU Memory holding the base-quantized weight matrix and input vector, feeding a Base GEMV that produces o_b, while CPU Memory holds a quantized weight-residual matrix. A four-step, numbered Dynamic Error Compensation pipeline runs alongside: Channel Selection picks salient input channels (sc_indices) from the activation vector, Residual Fetch retrieves the corresponding quantized residuals from CPU memory over PCIe (dashed arrows), Residual GEMV computes the correction term, and Addition combines it with the base GEMV output to form the final result. The figure uses gray flat-filled boxes with black borders, circled step numbers, and an explicit legend distinguishing solid within-GPU arrows from dashed CPU-via-PCIe arrows.
summary_zh: 该图展示 DecDEC 的整体设计：GPU 内存中的基础量化权重与输入向量计算基础 GEMV 输出，同时四步动态误差补偿流程（通道选择、经 PCIe 从 CPU 内存取残差、残差 GEMV、相加）并行运行，最终将补偿项与基础输出相加得到最终结果。
